The upstream tree is vendored under third_party/winvita. Preserve its
LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md when redistributing this repository.
Touhou-specific startup, diagnostics, and future Win32 shims belong in this
repository, not in the generic runtime.
